category_summary: **Launch of the week — Bot Screen / Hermes Desktop:** The clear headline is @NousResearch's flagship **[Bot Screen announcement](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa)** — live-streaming any agent's session with interactive takeover via **Hermes Desktop** (score 98, highest engagement in the batch). @Teknium followed with a [first-party post on live desktop passthrough](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) to the same machine the **Hermes Agent** runs on, and the official account amplified [@tonbistudio's walkthrough video plus docs](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d) (with a [@Teknium boost of the guide video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9)). Sentiment is emphatically positive and anticipatory: @Teknium's ['Finallllly!'](?!/?) and ['Much needed!'](?) (203 likes) frame it as a long-awaited ship, and @NousResearch's ['This is the way' reply](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-7fdb2254d801) kept the tone celebratory. **Community OSS — the Jev ecosystem:** @rlaope's oh-my-hermes (**OMH**) plugin gained **[Jev-Skills, Jev models/aliases, and model routing](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8)**, positioning OMH as the [all-in-one plugin for hermes-agent power users](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f), alongside the newly open-sourced **[jeval evaluation/visualization tool](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-99948938337f)** (near-duplicate share excluded) — a sign of grassroots momentum around Jev fast decision-making in Hermes workflows. **Maintainer engagement:** Core-team responsiveness is a strong secondary thread — @Teknium firmly [disputed a cache-bug claim and routed it to the issue tracker](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec), [fixed a user-reported issue same-day](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b), and corrected attribution that the disputed tooling was [built by **@NousResearch**, not Anthropic](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21). items.content:
You can now watch your agents work live as Hermes Desktop streams the screen of any bot's screen or session in real time. 

Watch it drive a browser, type into a terminal, or open a window. Take over anytime to interact with the Bot Screen or type credentials and seamlessly hand back off when you're done.
